up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records for the enzyme CYP2B6 (Cytochrome P450 2B6). Join metabolism with target_dictionary on enzyme_tid to filter by pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2B6'. Join compound_records (aliased as substrate_rec) on substrate_record_id to obtain the compound_name and molregno, then join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles as the substrate structure. Also join compound_records (aliased as drug_rec) on drug_record_id to retrieve the compound_name as the parent compound. Return the canonical SMILES (substrate_structure), substrate compound name, parent compound name, met_conversion, pathway_key, and organism. Order by met_id ascending and limit to 200 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  sub_rec.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  drug_rec.compound_name AS parent_compound_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
JOIN target_dictionary td ON m.enzyme_tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records sub_rec ON m.substrate_record_id = sub_rec.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON sub_rec.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records drug_rec ON m.drug_record_id = drug_rec.record_id
WHERE td.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2B6'
ORDER BY m.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200
